goal: Allow processes connecting over IPC to read chain data and subscribe to chain events
Unblock running the Bitcoin Core wallet in a separate process
Provide a stable interface for external tooling without freezing internal APIs
agreement: Broad support for wallet separation, dashboards, and external indexers (ariard, willcl-ark, rustaceanrob)
Verified using Rust wallet and Electrs IPC integrations (darosior, Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts on notification errors, author points to fix in #36520 (xyzconstant)
Approval with no project history and no stated reason (Big621)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it unblocks out-of-process wallet separation (#10102)
Crucial step for the multiprocess Bitcoin Core architecture
Also lets external clients and custom indexers inspect chain state directly over IPC
